content:
External feedback links

Tally form and Kahana features page linked from capabilities copy and header help.

What this is

Oasis links to Kahana features documentation and a Tally feedback form from capabilities text and header help so you can report gaps outside the thumbs flow.

How to use it

  • Use Send feedback for broad product ideas.
  • Use thumbs for message-specific quality.
  • Use Kahana docs for how-to articles maintained on the web.

Notes and limits

Links open in a normal tab; they require network access.
